{"rule":"Return this JSON object with the rule field unchanged and, in the text field, the passage of about 250 words that comes immediately AFTER the current text in the same story.","text":"A glass of water stood at each place. Beneath the table, Mara could see two pairs of shoes, neatly aligned, though no one sat in the chairs.

“Whose are those?” she asked.

The woman did not answer. She was watching the windows.

Mara approached the table. One glass was full; the other held only a mouthful. A folded sheet of paper lay between them. Her name was written on it in the careful block letters she had used as a child.

She opened it.

IF SHE ASKS YOU TO SIT, KEEP WALKING.

Across the street, a window slid shut. Then another. The sounds traveled toward them, floor by floor, until only the kitchen window remained open behind them.

The woman reached for the paper. Mara stepped away.

“You wrote this,” the woman said.

“When?”

“Before you forgot.”

Mara looked at the empty chairs. The shoes beneath them were wet, and water had begun to gather around their soles. Not rainwater: it was clear and cold against the toe of her boot.

From the far end of the street came the soft click of a door opening. A little girl stood in the doorway of a house Mara had not noticed before. She held a drawing in both hands.

“Mum?” the girl called.

The woman beside Mara closed her eyes.

Mara knew, without seeing it, what the drawing showed: yellow walls, a clock above a stove, and someone waiting at the window. She folded the note and put it in her pocket.

Then she walked toward the girl."}
